regions.finding: The original rendered page contains bibliographic citations only in this region. Several titles describe allene reactions, but they are prior literature rather than current-paper experiment arrows, tables, procedures, or outcomes; no reaction record was created from the references.

The authors thank Mr Youai Qiu for reproducing Table 3 entry 8, compound 4p in Figure 3, and compound 4w in Figure 6. These statements were linked to the three existing records; because the page provides no separate conditions or independent measurements, no duplicate experiments were created.
